P.text: During campaign creation in _createCampaign() inside DistributionCreator, the protocol applies fees to the reward amount, and a minimum reward-per-epoch invariant is checked.
P.evidence_quote: During campaign creation, the protocol applies fees to the reward amount

I.text: The minimum reward-per-epoch invariant should be evaluated against the post-fee distributed amount (the actual tokens delivered to the Distributor per epoch).
I.evidence_quote: The check uses the before fee removal campaign amount instead of the after fee removal distributed amount

V.text: The check is performed on the pre-fee campaign amount instead of the post-fee amount, allowing creators to bypass the minimum amount distributed per-epoch requirement and create campaigns with underfunded per-epoch rewards.
V.evidence_quote: The check: rewardTokenMinAmount() is performed on the pre fee campaign amount instead of the post fee amount.
